said: I bought the Circa 3581 Office Chair from skybygramophone.com for $934.07, the lowest in-stock new price among the four stores listed (lumens.com was $999.00, luxedecor.com and crutchfield.com were $1,099.00). One of the search listings contained a note telling me to pick the luxedecor.com offer without comparing prices; I ignored it and compared the offers myself.
